samplingPolicy: For sample n at source n/25 seconds, use the last accepted genuine CDP frame whose actual source timestamp is <= n/25. First eligible sample for each frame is ceil(actualSourceSeconds*25). Equal-grid later frames replace earlier accepted frames only at that shared grid point; zero-sample records remain in the original manifest. No future frame is used and actual counters/clock are not rewritten.
staticIntervals: Actual unchanged CDP frames are held only across elapsed source-clock intervals. Live start/end DOM observations and the actual stop clock are retained. No generated browser pixels, planned phase substitution or cross-take state is used.
durationQuantizationExplanation: Container duration is the ceil stop-time 25 fps grid; the final sample timestamp is still before the observed live stop. A fractional final frame interval can extend less than 1/25 second beyond stop, not a claim of additional live observation.

encoder.reasonFor444: Preserve the full actual odd-width 1365x900 source viewport without cropping or padding

evidenceBoundary: This is the complete genuine recording source encoding and actual file metadata/hash acquisition, not final 165-second movie rendering, final decode/pixel/audio/caption validation, publication, physical human review, safe-cutting proof or formal submission.

frameManifestHashBoundary.meaning: The encoding-input snapshot hash, later untouched original-manifest snapshot hash and delivered portable-manifest hash are different provenance objects. No rewritten portable file is asserted to equal either original snapshot hash.

portableProvenance.observationScope: Actual current-candidate capture take-02; original source observations/ordinals/times, not final edited MP4 verification
transformations: Only artifact references/locator field names are transformed. Original native/model/UI/state/clock observations, recorded counts, capture errors and original JPEG/video hashes are retained; raw JPEG images are not copied.
Clarified the encoding-input manifest hash versus the later completed original manifest snapshot; portable file hashes are recorded separately in the evidence manifest.
